transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’m having a really hard time keeping things organized. I’m trying to manage my schoolwork and also a little accessories shop, and everything just ends up in piles—supplies, due dates, receipts, assignment notes. I look at it all and I don’t know what to do first.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted when trying to focus on a task?

Yes, pretty often. Like in class, or even when I’m watching a video for my business assignments, I’ll start out paying attention, but after a few minutes my mind drifts to charm designs or order ideas. Then I realize I missed a big part of what was said.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?
Yes. Even when I’m not actually doing anything, I feel like my body is kind of buzzing. If I’m supposed to sit still and listen, I really notice it—I feel like I need to move or shift around.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?

Yes. In class discussions or group critiques, I’ll jump in with an answer before the other person is even finished talking. Then I realize I kind of guessed what they were going to say, and I feel embarrassed afterward.
Do you often feel anxious or irritable?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get annoyed sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed it being a big ongoing thing. Anxiety, maybe here and there, but not something I’ve paid much attention to.
Do you often find yourself talking a lot more than others in social situations?
I’m not sure. I don’t really pay attention to whether I talk more than other people. I might sometimes, but it’s not something I’ve clearly noticed.
Do you have trouble waiting for your turn in line or when speaking with others?

Yeah, I do. Waiting my turn to talk is hard, especially in critiques or if I’m trying to ask a question after class. I get really impatient and kind of shift around, and sometimes I cut in before I even mean to. Lines are hard too, like financial aid lines—I just feel restless waiting.
Are you able to engage in quiet leisure activities, like reading or drawing, without feeling the need to get up and do something else?

Not really. Even if I’m just sitting there, I feel like my body is kind of buzzing, like I need to move. It’s worse when I’m supposed to be sitting still and listening, but even with quiet stuff, I start feeling like I need to get up or shift around.
As a child, were you often described as being overly active or having a lot of excess energy?

Yeah, apparently I was. My mom still has notes from elementary school where teachers said I was always getting out of my seat, talking before they called on me, and kind of rushing through group activities even when I knew what I was doing.
Were you often getting into physical fights or having physical altercations as a child?
I don’t really know. I don’t remember being in fights like that, and I don’t think that was a big thing for me.
Do you have trouble staying focused or following instructions not just in school, but also when managing your accessories shop?

Yeah, I do. If a teacher or someone in a vendor meeting gives me a few steps, I’ll usually do the first part fine, but then later I’ll realize I missed something important. Like I forgot to attach a form, or I didn’t finish the last part of an order note. It happens enough that it causes problems.
Have you experienced these symptoms of disorganization, restlessness, and impulsivity consistently since childhood, or have they varied in severity over the years?

Yeah, it’s been there since I was little. Like I said, my mom still has those notes from elementary school where teachers wrote that I was always out of my seat, talking before they called on me, and rushing through group stuff even when I understood the work. It’s changed some over time, but it wasn’t something that just started recently.
Do you have difficulty following through on instructions or finishing tasks not just in school, but also when working on your accessories shop?

Yeah, that happens a lot. If a teacher or someone in a vendor meeting gives me a few steps, I’ll usually do the first part, but then later I find out I skipped something important, like attaching a form or finishing the last part of an order note.
Do you have trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes in your accessories shop, similar to what you experience in school?
I’m not totally sure. I know I miss steps sometimes, but with tiny details or careless mistakes specifically, I’d have to think about it more. I haven’t really tracked it that way.
Do you feel like your difficulties with organization, restlessness, and impulsivity are causing problems in your relationships or daily life?

Yeah, it is causing problems. Like, I missed some required steps for my program, and now my financial aid is kind of at risk because of it. And with my shop projects, people have started depending on me less because I don’t always follow through the way I’m supposed to. It’s frustrating.
Do you often have trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes in both your schoolwork and your accessories shop?

I’m not really sure if I’d say that happens often in both. I know I miss steps or forget parts of instructions sometimes, but with details or careless mistakes specifically, I haven’t really paid enough attention to say for sure.
Do you feel like your difficulties are affecting your relationships with friends or family?

Yeah, it is. I think people are kind of losing trust in me. With my shop projects, they don’t depend on me as much now because I haven’t followed through on things. And outside of that, I missed required steps for my program, so now my financial aid is at risk. It’s been causing real problems.
Do you think your difficulties with restlessness and impulsivity are as significant as your problems with organization and paying attention?

Yeah, I think the restlessness is pretty significant too. Even if I’m not actually going anywhere, I feel like my body is kind of buzzing, like I need to move. It’s especially bad when I’m supposed to just sit still and listen.
Do you often have trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes in both your schoolwork and your accessories shop?

I’m not totally sure. I know sometimes things get missed, but I haven’t really noticed if it’s specifically because I’m not paying attention to details or making careless mistakes in both school and the shop. I’d have to think about it more.
Have your difficulties with organization, restlessness, and impulsivity caused significant problems in your daily life or relationships?

Yes, definitely. It’s caused real problems day to day. I missed required steps for my program, and now my financial aid is at risk. And with the shop projects, people have started relying on me less because I haven’t followed through the way I should have.
